metadata.title: ओडिशा के आदिवासी मुख्यमंत्री मोहन चरण माझी का सफ़र | Mohan Charan Majhi: Tribal CM Of Odisha
metadata.description: The senior tribal leader of Odisha BJP and 4 times MLA Mohan Charan Majhi sworn in as Chief Minister of Odisha on 12 June 2024. Prime minister Narendara Modi and UP CM Yogi Aditya Nath were present at the ceremony in Bhubaneswar Know who he is Mohan Charan Majhi
